title: Long-Lead Deposit Percent for Cabinetry and Countertops Ordered Early — Design Studio Selections
content:
On a Design Studio Selections file, the long-lead deposit percent is set by the price of the cabinetry and countertop lines added while the agreement's construction stage was foundation or framing:

| Cabinetry and countertop lines added at foundation or framing | Long-lead deposit percent |
|---|---|
| Total 5000.00 or more | 100 percent |
| Total less than 5000.00 | 75 percent |
| None | The finish deposit percent |

**Records read.** The category and the construction stage shown on each option line's selection entry in the design ledger, and the line prices.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical)**

- Lines totalling 5000.00: 100 percent.
- Lines totalling 4999.99: 75 percent.
- Cabinetry added only at drywall: no line was added at foundation or framing, so the finish deposit percent.
